hooks.command: { d="$HOME/Library/Application Support/Hushtop/inbox"; mkdir -p "$d" && chmod 700 "$d"; n=$(basename "${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-$PWD}" | tr -cd '[:alnum:]._ -' | cut -c1-80); a=$(printf '%s' "${__CFBundleIdentifier:-}" | tr -cd '[:alnum:].-' | cut -c1-120); t=$(printf '%s' "${TERM_PROGRAM:-}" | tr -cd '[:alnum:]._+-' | cut -c1-40); y=$(ps -o tty= -p $PPID 2>/dev/null | tr -cd '[:alnum:]' | cut -c1-12); s=$( (head -c 65536; cat >/dev/null) | tr -d '\n' | sed -n 's/.*"session_id"[[:space:]]*:[[:space:]]*"\([A-Za-z0-9-]*\)".*/\1/p' | cut -c1-64); f="claude-$$-$(date +%s).json"; printf '{"agent":"claude","project":"%s","event":"notification","app":"%s","term":"%s","session":"%s","tty":"%s"}' "$n" "$a" "$t" "$s" "$y" > "$d/.$f.tmp" && mv "$d/.$f.tmp" "$d/$f"; } >/dev/null 2>&1; exit 0 # mynotch-hook

{ d="$HOME/Library/Application Support/Hushtop/inbox"; mkdir -p "$d" && chmod 700 "$d"; n=$(basename "${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-$PWD}" | tr -cd '[:alnum:]._ -' | cut -c1-80); a=$(printf '%s' "${__CFBundleIdentifier:-}" | tr -cd '[:alnum:].-' | cut -c1-120); t=$(printf '%s' "${TERM_PROGRAM:-}" | tr -cd '[:alnum:]._+-' | cut -c1-40); y=$(ps -o tty= -p $PPID 2>/dev/null | tr -cd '[:alnum:]' | cut -c1-12); s=$( (head -c 65536; cat >/dev/null) | tr -d '\n' | sed -n 's/.*"session_id"[[:space:]]*:[[:space:]]*"\([A-Za-z0-9-]*\)".*/\1/p' | cut -c1-64); f="claude-$$-$(date +%s).json"; printf '{"agent":"claude","project":"%s","event":"stop","app":"%s","term":"%s","session":"%s","tty":"%s"}' "$n" "$a" "$t" "$s" "$y" > "$d/.$f.tmp" && mv "$d/.$f.tmp" "$d/$f"; } >/dev/null 2>&1; exit 0 # mynotch-hook

{ d="$HOME/Library/Application Support/Hushtop/inbox"; mkdir -p "$d" && chmod 700 "$d"; n=$(basename "${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-$PWD}" | tr -cd '[:alnum:]._ -' | cut -c1-80); a=$(printf '%s' "${__CFBundleIdentifier:-}" | tr -cd '[:alnum:].-' | cut -c1-120); t=$(printf '%s' "${TERM_PROGRAM:-}" | tr -cd '[:alnum:]._+-' | cut -c1-40); y=$(ps -o tty= -p $PPID 2>/dev/null | tr -cd '[:alnum:]' | cut -c1-12); s=$( (head -c 65536; cat >/dev/null) | tr -d '\n' | sed -n 's/.*"session_id"[[:space:]]*:[[:space:]]*"\([A-Za-z0-9-]*\)".*/\1/p' | cut -c1-64); f="claude-$$-$(date +%s).json"; printf '{"agent":"claude","project":"%s","event":"start","app":"%s","term":"%s","session":"%s","tty":"%s"}' "$n" "$a" "$t" "$s" "$y" > "$d/.$f.tmp" && mv "$d/.$f.tmp" "$d/$f"; } >/dev/null 2>&1; exit 0 # mynotch-hook
if [ -x '/Applications/Hushtop.app/Contents/Helpers/mynotch-statusline' ]; then exec '/Applications/Hushtop.app/Contents/Helpers/mynotch-statusline' claude-ask; fi # mynotch-ask
